title: Cosmological Growth Constraints on Λ-Locked Discrete Entropic Gravity
abstract: Stress-tests the cosmological viability of discrete entropic gravity with Λ-locked screening by comparing three transition-scale scenarios against linear structure-formation observables. Only the Λ-locked scenario (L_Λ = 4.4 Gpc) preserves a realistic σ₈ ≈ 0.8, while sub-Hubble transitions at 10 Mpc and 1 Mpc produce catastrophic overgrowth (σ₈ >> 1). Establishes Λ-locking (L_Λ ≳ H₀⁻¹) as a necessary condition for cosmological consistency.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Cosmological scales; viability of discrete gravity under linear growth

key_results: Λ-locked scenario (4.4 Gpc) yields σ₈ = 0.814 with only 0.4% excess over ΛCDM
